text:
Nora Li: quick idea  run a Mentor Micro-cert + Office Hours pilot for SI onboarding. tiny badge (15-30m teaching slot) + short quiz. goal: scale mentor pool and surface trainer-ready folks.
Ben Turner: love it. micro-cert could be 'Live Lab Lead' badge. criteria: teach one lab, pass mentor rubric, and shadow a proctored session.
Rashida Ahmed: operational Qs: how do we schedule office hours across timezones? propose repeating a 90m slot at 08:00 PT and 20:00 PT to hit EU/APAC overlap. mentors rotate weekly.
Nora Li: mirror that. also want an automated badge issuer integration so SIs get a verifiable badge link on completion. DevEx, can we wire Credly-like webhook?
Ben Turner: yep — we have a lightweight badge webhook we can reuse. need: participant email, badge id, and evidence URL (recording or mentor eval).
vendor-nexus-bot: NexusCloud: confirmed extra rack window 2024-12-02..2024-12-09 for proctored labs. please submit AUP checklist 7 days before.
Rashida Ahmed: thanks. action items: 1) playbook one-pager (Nora) 2) badge flow spec (Ben) 3) office-hours rota + signup form (Rashida) 4) Nexus AUP submit (Ben). target: publish pilot signups by 2024-11-15 (1820217600).
Nora Li: also suggest a tiny mentor FAQ and an incident quickfix cheat sheet (OOM, auth errors, model mismatch). i'll draft both.
Ben Turner: sample cheat snippet I'll add to the playbook: 
```
Issue: inference 500 errors
Quickfix: check model variant, restart endpoint, clear KV cache, escalate to eng-oncall if persists
```
onboarding-bot: event created: "Mentor Micro-cert Pilot Planning" 2024-11-07 11:00 PT. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/mentor-microcert
Rashida Ahmed: i'll spin up the Google form for mentor signups and include timezone preference + short bio. will post link here when ready.
Nora Li: perfect. if anyone wants to co-host the first shadow week DM me. :raised_hands:
